_comment: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and adapt it. Without config.json these defaults apply.

whatsapp.chat: <exact name of the chat to read, as it appears in WhatsApp Web>

_catalogo: manutentore: true only for whoever publishes the catalog. Everyone else keeps it false: your own entries then go to the *.local.json files, which git ignores, so git pull never clashes with them. url_pagine (maintainer only, optional): public address of the web pages, for the hreflang links.

catalogo.fonte: reels and links saved in chat

_github: Optional. Raises the GitHub API quota from 60 to 5000 requests/hour, so a full --refresh finishes in one pass. Create it with NO scopes (classic) or 'Public repositories, read-only' (fine-grained): reading public repo metadata needs no permission, so a leaked token grants nothing. GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment takes precedence and is the safer place for it; the token below is only read if config.json is gitignored.
